name: Knaves
summary: A trick-taking avoidance game where players win points for tricks but lose points for capturing Jacks.
rules_text: Knaves is for 3 players with a 52-card French deck. One card is turned face up for trump after dealing. Each player receives 17 cards. In rotation, eldest leads any card. Others must follow suit if able, otherwise may play any card including trump. Highest card of the led suit wins unless trumped; highest trump wins the trick. Winner leads next. No other special plays. Scoring per hand: +1 point per trick taken, minus penalties for Jacks: J♠ = -1, J♣ = -2, J♦ = -3, J♥ = -4. Points accumulate over hands. First player to reach 20 total points wins.
